linux.binding_boundary: Standalone stdout embeds no module hash; initial-stage auxiliary proof. Final optimized Linux evidence supplies exact executable/source/module bindings.

final_native_standalone.single_runtime_scope: 90 cases compare C baseline and Mojo-enabled all-singleton groups; zero panel preparation/allocation metadata and zero Mojo work asserted.
final_native_standalone.fpcr_scope: 32 combinations of four rounding modes, FZ, FZ16 and DN using finite half-scale edge fixtures; complete output words and guards compared to C.
final_native_standalone.unwind_scope: RtlLookupFunctionEntry finds final kernel unwind entry and expected image base; linked COFF audit records unwind metadata. This is a lookup/metadata check.

final_linux.boundary: ASAN/UBSAN instrument harness and listed current C bridge/kernel sources. Mojo machine code and prebuilt common/static-library objects are not instrumented. Exact words, guards and immutable-input hashes supplement this boundary.

final_native_model.boundary: Six fixed-input widths at 64 positions and two short multi-turn sessions. Hybrid selected MTP fallback in both sampler checks, so final sessions do not establish actual ngram/MTP switching. Model receipts omit per-operator Mojo counters; kernel tests and performance diagnostics separately establish dispatch.

final_native_units.scope: Final optimized DLL and corrected checker; 68 accepted executable results include four genuine platform/GPU conditional skips. No performance claim.

limitations: Functional proof only; no tokens-per-second gain or default promotion claim.
Word totals include guards/stride padding and are not counts of distinct logical model logits.
No full-context, sustained-load, NPU/GPU, trained-drafter or broad Snapdragon device coverage established.
Initial and optimized modules are distinct epochs; historical results are not relabeled as final-module results.

checker_epoch.binding: Post-benchmark working-tree content hashes; no delivery commit assumed. C engine and Mojo module bytes are unchanged.
checker_epoch.behavior: Valid Mojo JSON skipped=false reports explicit_skip=false. JSON skipped=true or genuine non-JSON skip text is rejected.
